pages.content: # Error Reference Every error code the SDK, the MCP server and the paymaster client can return: what it means, why it happens, how to fix it, the HTTP status route handlers use and whether a retry can help. Each code has a stable anchor, so the `docsUrl` on a `PepuError` (`https://guide.pepeunchained.com/reference/errors#`) lands on its entry. Paste an error into [`explainError`](../sdk/errors.md) or the MCP tool `pepu_explain_error` to get its entry directly. > Status: generated from the SDK error catalog (37 codes) and the paymaster denial-reason map (43 reasons). The catalog is built and tested. `node scripts/gen-docs.mjs --check` fails CI if this page drifts from the code. ## Prerequisites - None. For the SDK functions that produce these errors, see [SDK Error Catalog](../sdk/errors.md). ## Index | Code | HTTP | Retryable | Meaning | |---|---|---|---| | [`CONFIG_BAD_URL`](#CONFIG_BAD_URL) | 500 | no | Invalid endpoint URL | | [`CONFIG_MISSING_ENV`](#CONFIG_MISSING_ENV) | 500 | no | Missing environment variable | | [`CONFIG_ORIGIN_MISMATCH`](#CONFIG_ORIGIN_MISMATCH) | 500 | no | Origin is not allowed by Privy | | [`CONFIG_PRIVY_CREATE_ON_LOGIN`](#CONFIG_PRIVY_CREATE_ON_LOGIN) | 500 | no | Embedded wallet never appears after login | | [`CONFIG_PRIVY_DASHBOARD`](#CONFIG_PRIVY_DASHBOARD) | 500 | no | Privy dashboard misconfiguration | | [`CONFIG_SERVER_ONLY`](#CONFIG_SERVER_ONLY) | 500 | no | Server-only module imported in the browser | | [`AUTH_INVALID_TOKEN`](#AUTH_INVALID_TOKEN) | 401 | no | Invalid or missing Privy access token | | [`WALLET_COINBASE_UNSUPPORTED_CHAIN`](#WALLET_COINBASE_UNSUPPORTED_CHAIN) | 400 | no | Coinbase Smart Wallet does not support PEPU | | [`WALLET_INJECTED_ACTIVE`](#WALLET_INJECTED_ACTIVE) | 400 | no | An injected browser wallet is the active account | | [`WALLET_NOT_PROVISIONED`](#WALLET_NOT_PROVISIONED) | 409 | yes | User has no embedded wallet yet | | [`PRIVY_CHAIN_REJECTED_97741`](#PRIVY_CHAIN_REJECTED_97741) | 502 | no | Privy rejects server-side eth_sendTransaction on PEPU | | [`PRIVY_KEY_QUORUM_MISMATCH`](#PRIVY_KEY_QUORUM_MISMATCH) | 500 | no | Privy authorization key does not match the wallet owner | | [`POLICY_NAME_TOO_LONG`](#POLICY_NAME_TOO_LONG) | 400 | no | Privy policy or rule name is too long | | [`POLICY_UNSCOPED`](#POLICY_UNSCOPED) | 400 | no | Session policy is not scoped | | [`SESSION_APPROVAL_MISMATCH`](#SESSION_APPROVAL_MISMATCH) | 409 | no | Session approval does not match | | [`SESSION_EXPIRED`](#SESSION_EXPIRED) | 410 | no | Session expired | | [`SESSION_NONE`](#SESSION_NONE) | 409 | no | No active session | | [`BUNDLER_AA_FAILED`](#BUNDLER_AA_FAILED) | 502 | no | EntryPoint rejected the UserOperation | | [`BUNDLER_UNREACHABLE`](#BUNDLER_UNREACHABLE) | 502 | yes | Bundler or paymaster is unreachable | | [`PAYMASTER_API_ERROR`](#PAYMASTER_API_ERROR) | 502 | no | Paymaster API request failed | | [`PAYMASTER_CAP`](#PAYMASTER_CAP) | 429 | yes | Sponsorship cap reached | | [`PAYMASTER_DENIED`](#PAYMASTER_DENIED) | 403 | no | Paymaster denied the sponsorship | | [`PAYMASTER_DESTINATION_NOT_ALLOWED`](#PAYMASTER_DESTINATION_NOT_ALLOWED) | 403 | no | Paymaster refused the call destination | | [`PAYMASTER_FREE_TIER_UNAVAILABLE`](#PAYMASTER_FREE_TIER_UNAVAILABLE) | 429 | yes | Free tier cannot sponsor this operation | | [`PAYMASTER_IDENTITY_REQUIRED`](#PAYMASTER_IDENTITY_REQUIRED) | 401 | no | A verified Privy account is required | | [`PAYMASTER_NO_BALANCE`](#PAYMASTER_NO_BALANCE) | 429 | yes | Sponsorship project has no balance | | [`PAYMASTER_ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED`](#PAYMASTER_ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED) | 403 | no | Paymaster refused the request origin | | [`PAYMASTER_PROJECT_NOT_CLAIMED`](#PAYMASTER_PROJECT_NOT_CLAIMED) | 409 | no | Sponsorship project is not claimed on-chain | | [`PAYMASTER_PROJECT_OWNER_CHANGED`](#PAYMASTER_PROJECT_OWNER_CHANGED) | 403 | no | Project owner changed since the credentials were issued | | [`PAYMASTER_PROJECT_PAUSED`](#PAYMASTER_PROJECT_PAUSED) | 403 | no | Sponsorship project is paused | | [`PAYMASTER_RATE_LIMITED`](#PAYMASTER_RATE_LIMITED) | 429 | yes | Paymaster API rate limit | | [`PAYMASTER_SESSION_REQUIRED`](#PAYMASTER_SESSION_REQUIRED) | 401 | no | Paymaster owner session missing or expired | | [`MULTICALL3_CANONICAL_ADDRESS`](#MULTICALL3_CANONICAL_ADDRESS) | 500 | no | Canonical Multicall3 address used on PEPU | | [`TX_GAS_UNDERSHOOT`](#TX_GAS_UNDERSHOOT) | 502 | yes | Gas limit too low | | [`TX_NONCE_RACE`](#TX_NONCE_RACE) | 409 | yes | Nonce conflict | | [`TX_REVERTED`](#TX_REVERTED) | 502 | no | Transaction reverted | | [`UNKNOWN`](#UNKNOWN) | 500 | no | Unknown error | ## Configuration ### CONFIG_BAD_URL **Invalid endpoint URL** - **HTTP status:** 500 - **Retryable:** no - **Cause:** A configured bundler, paymaster or RPC URL is not a valid http(s) URL. - **Fix:** Use a full URL such as https://bundler.example.com. ### CONFIG_MISSING_ENV **Missing environment variable** - **HTTP status:** 500 - **Retryable:** no - **Cause:** A required environment variable is not set. - **Fix:** Set the listed variables (see .env.example) and restart the process. ### CONFIG_ORIGIN_MISMATCH **Origin is not allowed by Privy** - **HTTP status:** 500 - **Retryable:** no - **Cause:** The page origin (scheme, host and port) is not in the Privy app's allowed origins. A different dev port is the usual cause. - **Fix:** Add the exact origin, including the port, to Privy dashboard Allowed origins. ### CONFIG_PRIVY_CREATE_ON_LOGIN **Embedded wallet never appears after login** - **HTTP status:** 500 - **Retryable:** no - **Cause:** The dashboard's automatic embedded wallet creation is off, so createOnLogin never resolves. - **Fix:** Create the wallet server-side with the ensure-wallet route (createEnsureWalletRoute), or enable creation in the Privy dashboard. ### CONFIG_PRIVY_DASHBOARD **Privy dashboard misconfiguration** - **HTTP status:** 500 - **Retryable:** no - **Cause:** A required Privy dashboard setting is missing. - **Fix:** Run checkPrivyDashboardConfig() and follow its fix list. ### CONFIG_SERVER_ONLY **Server-only module imported in the browser** - **HTTP status:** 500 - **Retryable:** no - **Cause:** A server entry point was bundled into client code. - **Fix:** Import server entries only from route handlers, server actions and scripts. ## Auth and wallet ### AUTH_INVALID_TOKEN **Invalid or missing Privy access token** - **HTTP status:** 401 - **Retryable:** no - **Cause:** The request carried no bearer token, or Privy could not verify it. - **Fix:** Send Authorization: Bearer and verify the token server-side. ### WALLET_COINBASE_UNSUPPORTED_CHAIN **Coinbase Smart Wallet does not support PEPU** - **HTTP status:** 400 - **Retryable:** no - **Cause:** Coinbase Smart Wallet is a smart-contract wallet on chains it knows; PEPU (97741) is not one of them, and it floods the console with unsupported-chain errors. - **Fix:** Pin Coinbase to eoaOnly via createPepuPrivyConfig() from @pepu-chain/sdk/privy. ### WALLET_INJECTED_ACTIVE **An injected browser wallet is the active account** - **HTTP status:** 400 - **Retryable:** no - **Cause:** wagmi's active account is a browser extension rather than the Privy embedded wallet. - **Fix:** Pin the embedded wallet with useActiveWalletPin() from @pepu-chain/sdk/privy/wagmi. ### WALLET_NOT_PROVISIONED **User has no embedded wallet yet** - **HTTP status:** 409 - **Retryable:** yes - **Cause:** The user is signed in but no embedded Ethereum wallet exists. - **Fix:** Call the ensure-wallet route (useEnsureWallet or WalletGate) before acting. ## Privy ### PRIVY_CHAIN_REJECTED_97741 **Privy rejects server-side eth_sendTransaction on PEPU** - **HTTP status:** 502 - **Retryable:** no - **Cause:** Privy's server-side send path does not know chain 97741 and rejects it. Signing works; sending does not. - **Fix:** Sign with eth_signTransaction on the server and broadcast the raw transaction yourself (signAndBroadcast from @pepu-chain/sdk/session). ### PRIVY_KEY_QUORUM_MISMATCH **Privy authorization key does not match the wallet owner** - **HTTP status:** 500 - **Retryable:** no - **Cause:** Privy returned 401 'No valid authorization keys or user signing keys available': the server's PRIVY_AUTHORIZATION_KEY is not a signer on the wallet, or the key quorum id differs from the one the user granted. - **Fix:** Make sure PRIVY_AUTHORIZATION_KEY is the private half of the key whose quorum id is NEXT_PUBLIC_PRIVY_KEY_QUORUM_ID, and that the user granted that quorum as a signer. ## Session keys and policies ### POLICY_NAME_TOO_LONG **Privy policy or rule name is too long** - **HTTP status:** 400 - **Retryable:** no - **Cause:** Privy rejects policy and rule names of 50 or more characters (the real limit is 49). - **Fix:** Shorten the policy or rule name to 49 characters or fewer. ### POLICY_UNSCOPED **Session policy is not scoped** - **HTTP status:** 400 - **Retryable:** no - **Cause:** A session policy needs a target contract, at least one function and an expiry. - **Fix:** Pass contractAddress, functions and expiresAtUnixSeconds to buildSessionPolicy(). ### SESSION_APPROVAL_MISMATCH **Session approval does not match** - **HTTP status:** 409 - **Retryable:** no - **Cause:** The approval was made for another account, permission id or mode. - **Fix:** Re-run prepare, have the owner sign again, then activate. ### SESSION_EXPIRED **Session expired** - **HTTP status:** 410 - **Retryable:** no - **Cause:** The session's expiry has passed. - **Fix:** Grant a new session. ### SESSION_NONE **No active session** - **HTTP status:** 409 - **Retryable:** no - **Cause:** The user has not granted a session, or it was revoked. - **Fix:** Ask the user to grant a session first. ## Bundler ### BUNDLER_AA_FAILED **EntryPoint rejected the UserOperation** - **HTTP status:** 502 - **Retryable:** no - **Cause:** The EntryPoint reported FailedOp with an AAxx code during validation or execution. - **Fix:** Read the AAxx code: AA21 prefund missing, AA23 signature or validation reverted, AA25 invalid nonce, AA31/AA33/AA34 paymaster problems. ### BUNDLER_UNREACHABLE **Bundler or paymaster is unreachable** - **HTTP status:** 502 - **Retryable:** yes - **Cause:** The request to the bundler or paymaster URL failed before any response. - **Fix:** Check PEPU_BUNDLER_URL and PEPU_PAYMASTER_URL. The hosted services may not be live yet; use checkSponsorship(). ## Paymaster and sponsorship ### PAYMASTER_API_ERROR **Paymaster API request failed** - **HTTP status:** 502 - **Retryable:** no - **Cause:** The paymaster API returned an error that has no more specific PEPU code. - **Fix:** Read error.details (HTTP status and the service's error code) and the OpenAPI spec for that route. ### PAYMASTER_CAP **Sponsorship cap reached** - **HTTP status:** 429 - **Retryable:** yes - **Cause:** A daily, per-sender or per-operation sponsorship cap was hit. - **Fix:** Wait for the cap window to reset, or raise the project's daily and sender limits. ### PAYMASTER_DENIED **Paymaster denied the sponsorship** - **HTTP status:** 403 - **Retryable:** no - **Cause:** The paymaster rejected the credential or the sender (for example unknown_or_invalid_app_credential or sender_not_owned_by_token_user). - **Fix:** Check the app credential or token, and that the smart account belongs to the user whose access token you sent. ### PAYMASTER_DESTINATION_NOT_ALLOWED **Paymaster refused the call destination** - **HTTP status:** 403 - **Retryable:** no - **Cause:** The UserOperation targets a contract that is not on the project's target allowlist. - **Fix:** Add the contract to the project's targets, or sponsor only calls to allowed targets. ### PAYMASTER_FREE_TIER_UNAVAILABLE **Free tier cannot sponsor this operation** - **HTTP status:** 429 - **Retryable:** yes - **Cause:** The free tier is disabled, its pool is empty, or the operation is larger than the per-op cap. - **Fix:** Deposit into your own project and use its credentials, or retry later. ### PAYMASTER_IDENTITY_REQUIRED **A verified Privy account is required** - **HTTP status:** 401 - **Retryable:** no - **Cause:** The free tier (and any project with requireIdentity on) only sponsors users with a verified Privy access token. - **Fix:** Send the user's Privy access token as Authorization: Bearer (or context.privyAccessToken for ERC-7677). ### PAYMASTER_NO_BALANCE **Sponsorship project has no balance** - **HTTP status:** 429 - **Retryable:** yes - **Cause:** The project's paymaster deposit cannot cover this operation. - **Fix:** Deposit more PEPU to the project, then retry. ### PAYMASTER_ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED **Paymaster refused the request origin** - **HTTP status:** 403 - **Retryable:** no - **Cause:** The request Origin is not on the project's allowlist. - **Fix:** Add the exact origin (scheme, host and port) to the project's allowed origins. ### PAYMASTER_PROJECT_NOT_CLAIMED **Sponsorship project is not claimed on-chain** - **HTTP status:** 409 - **Retryable:** no - **Cause:** Deposits can sit in an unclaimed project, but nothing is sponsored until its owner has claimed it on-chain (the contract reports ProjectNotClaimed, the service project_not_claimed_onchain). - **Fix:** Prove the Privy app (requestClaimAttestation from @pepu-chain/sdk/paymaster/server), call claimProject, then configureProject (setTargets, setDailyLimit, setSenderDailyLimit). ### PAYMASTER_PROJECT_OWNER_CHANGED **Project owner changed since the credentials were issued** - **HTTP status:** 403 - **Retryable:** no - **Cause:** The on-chain owner of the project is no longer the address the off-chain credentials were issued to (an ownership transfer or re-claim completed). - **Fix:** As the new owner, sign in with SIWE, register the project again and rotate the client token and server key. ### PAYMASTER_PROJECT_PAUSED **Sponsorship project is paused** - **HTTP status:** 403 - **Retryable:** no - **Cause:** The project owner paused sponsorship on-chain. - **Fix:** The owner can resume it with setPaused(projectId, false). ### PAYMASTER_RATE_LIMITED **Paymaster API rate limit** - **HTTP status:** 429 - **Retryable:** yes - **Cause:** Too many requests to the paymaster API from this IP or account. - **Fix:** Back off for the Retry-After interval (error.details.retryAfterSeconds when present). ### PAYMASTER_SESSION_REQUIRED **Paymaster owner session missing or expired** - **HTTP status:** 401 - **Retryable:** no - **Cause:** Owner endpoints need a SIWE session token (1 h lifetime) for the project's current on-chain owner. - **Fix:** Call loginWithWallet() on the paymaster API client, then retry. ## Transactions and chain ### MULTICALL3_CANONICAL_ADDRESS **Canonical Multicall3 address used on PEPU** - **HTTP status:** 500 - **Retryable:** no - **Cause:** PEPU's Multicall3 is not at the canonical 0xcA11...CA11 address. - **Fix:** Use getMulticall3() or pepuMulticall() from @pepu-chain/sdk, or the pepuMainnet chain object, which carries the right address. ### TX_GAS_UNDERSHOOT **Gas limit too low** - **HTTP status:** 502 - **Retryable:** yes - **Cause:** Nitro gas estimation undershoots on PEPU: the L1 data component is not covered by the plain estimate. - **Fix:** Add headroom to the estimate, 20% via withGasLimitBuffer() from @pepu-chain/sdk/session. ### TX_NONCE_RACE **Nonce conflict** - **HTTP status:** 409 - **Retryable:** yes - **Cause:** Two transactions raced for one nonce, or a replacement was underpriced. - **Fix:** Serialize sends per account (a lock), re-read the pending nonce, and retry. ### TX_REVERTED **Transaction reverted** - **HTTP status:** 502 - **Retryable:** no - **Cause:** The contract call reverted. - **Fix:** Decode the revert reason with explainError() and check arguments, allowances and balances. ### UNKNOWN **Unknown error** - **HTTP status:** 500 - **Retryable:** no - **Cause:** The error did not match any known PEPU failure. - **Fix:** Read the original message. Run pepu_known_gotchas in the MCP server, or search the docs. ## Paymaster denial reasons The policy service answers a denied request with a `reason` string. The SDK maps every reason to one of the codes above with `mapPaymasterReason(reason)` and `paymasterReasonToError(reason, message)` from `@pepu-chain/sdk/paymaster`. An unknown reason (a newer service) maps to `PAYMASTER_DENIED`. Reasons marked v1 come from the v1 paymaster; the rest come from the v2 policy service, which is built but not deployed. | Reason | Service | Maps to | Retryable | |---|---|---|---| | A bundler rejection surfaces as `BUNDLER_AA_FAILED` with the EntryPoint's `AAxx` code in the message (for example `AA21 didn't pay prefund`, `AA25 invalid account nonce`, `AA33 reverted` for a paymaster revert). A network or CORS failure surfaces as `BUNDLER_UNREACHABLE`. The JSON-RPC error table for the bundler is on [Bundler JSON-RPC API](../infra/bundler/api.md); the paymaster HTTP error table is on [REST API v1](../infra/paymaster/rest-api-v1.md) and [REST API v2](../infra/paymaster/rest-api-v2.md). ## What to expect - `pepu_health_check` and `pepu_sponsorship_status` probe the hosted bundler and the paymaster service base by default; set the variables to point elsewhere. - `node scripts/check-docs-parity.mjs` verifies the addresses and counts on the docs pages against the SDK registry. ## Common failures - You see a code that is not on this page: you are on an older SDK. Upgrade `@pepu-chain/sdk`, or run the error text through `pepu_explain_error`. - You see `UNKNOWN`: nothing in the catalog matched. Read the original `cause`, and see [Troubleshooting](../troubleshooting.md). ## Related - [SDK Error Catalog](../sdk/errors.md) - [Troubleshooting](../troubleshooting.md) - [Policy, Caps and the Circuit Breaker](../infra/paymaster/policy-and-caps.md) - [MCP Tool Reference](../mcp/tools.md)

pages.title: FAQ
pages.content:
# FAQ

Short answers to questions builders ask first, with links to the page that has the detail.

> Status: reference. Answers reflect the code on main; re-check hosting status before repeating it as current.

## Chain and network

**Which chain do I build on?** Pepe Unchained V2 mainnet, chain ID `97741`. Testnet `97740` is out of scope (no faucet, no indexed explorer, no deployed infrastructure). `3409` is the dead V1 chain. See [V1 vs V2](../get-started/v1-vs-v2.md).

**Why is gas so high in gwei?** PEPU is a low-value token; the base fee is around 12,500 gwei and a transfer still costs a fraction of a cent. Do not hardcode a lower price. See [Network Reference](../get-started/network-reference.md).

**Is Multicall3 at the usual address?** No. PEPU's is `0x9CE19273Ae9c24437DFF512E8DFCAed4E4B001bd`; the canonical address has no code. See [The Multicall3 Trap](../contracts/multicall3.md).

## Privy and login

**Login fails with a blocked iframe or 403.** The origin, including the port, is not in Allowed origins. Next.js may have moved to 3001. See [Dashboard Settings](../privy/dashboard-settings.md).

**"Creating your wallet..." never ends.** Use `PepuPrivyProvider` and `WalletGate`, which provision the wallet server-side. See [Embedded Wallets](../onboarding/privy-embedded-wallets.md).

**Do I need Smart Wallets in the Privy dashboard?** Only for the Privy Smart Wallets sponsorship transport. Not for login, Privy sessions or the combination.

**Which smart account setup should I use: ZeroDev-native or Privy Smart Wallets?** ZeroDev-native (the SDK builds the Kernel account) if you want sessions, the free tier, a server or a bot; Privy Smart Wallets for one gasless button in a client-only app. Users who just pay their own gas need neither. See [Smart Account Paths](../concepts/smart-account-paths.md).

**Why does my users' balance show 0 but they transacted?** With a smart account there are two addresses. See [The Two-Address Model](../onboarding/two-address-model.md).

## Sessions and sponsorship

**Privy session or Kernel session?** Privy: least setup, scope enforced by Privy, user pays gas. Kernel: scope enforced on-chain, usually sponsored, uses the hosted bundler and a funded project. See [Session Keys](../onboarding/session-keys.md).

**Is gas sponsorship available?** Yes. The hosted bundler (`https://bundler.pepeunchained.com`) and paymaster (`https://paymaster.pepeunchained.com`) are live and proven on mainnet. You bring a project (claim, set targets and limits, deposit, token); the free tier is only for PEPU's own Privy app. Check live with `pepu_sponsorship_status`, or run your own from `services/`. See [Sponsored Transactions](../onboarding/sponsored-transactions.md).

**Why did the second tap fail with `trailing-hour spend ... would exceed cap`?** Per-user caps are below the worst-case reservation (about 20.5 PEPU for a session's first operation, 6.9 later). Raise them.

**What is the tiered paymaster?** v2: a free tier (100 PEPU per Privy user per day and 50 PEPU per hour, PEPU's own Privy app only) plus project deposits. Deployed on mainnet as a canary: internally reviewed 3x, external audit pending, funded in small tranches. See [Sponsorship Tiers](../onboarding/sponsorship-tiers.md).

**Does revoking a Kernel session uninstall it on-chain?** No. The server key is deleted at once; the grant lapses at expiry. Keep sessions short.

## Agents and MCP

**How do I give my coding agent PEPU facts?** Install the MCP server (`npx -y @pepu-chain/mcp`) and, for Claude Code, the plugin. See [Build with an AI Coding Agent](../get-started/ai-assisted.md).

**Can the agent set up Privy?** It can scaffold, write env keys without printing secrets, generate the authorization key and check config. You must create the Privy app, copy the App ID and secret, and register the public key in the dashboard.

## Related

- [Glossary](glossary.md)
- [Troubleshooting](../troubleshooting.md)
- [Error Reference](errors.md)

pages.title: Glossary
pages.content:
# Glossary

Terms used across the PEPU docs, alphabetical.

> Status: reference.

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Alto | The open-source ERC-4337 bundler PEPU hosts at `bundler.pepeunchained.com`, configured with `--chain-type arbitrum`. |
| Approval | The owner's enable signature plus policy parameters for a Kernel session. Holds no secret. |
| Authorization key | A P-256 key whose public half is registered in Privy; the server signs signing requests with the private half. See [Authorization Keys](../privy/authorization-keys.md). |
| Bundler | A service that accepts UserOperations and submits them through the EntryPoint. |
| Call policy | A ZeroDev policy contract limiting a session to listed targets, selectors and value. PEPU has v0.0.4. |
| Chain ID | `97741` for mainnet. `3409` is the dead V1 chain. |
| Client token | A project's publishable paymaster credential (`ppt_`). Works only from the project's allowed origins. Used in the Privy Smart Wallets dashboard URL. See [Credential Matrix](../infra/paymaster/auth.md). |
| Combination | Google login plus one on-chain session plus sponsorship. See [End to End](../onboarding/google-session-sponsored.md). |
| Embedded wallet | The EOA Privy creates for a user at login. |
| EntryPoint | The ERC-4337 singleton. v0.7 is `0x0000000071727De22E5E9d8BAf0edAc6f37da032`. |
| `eoaOnly` | The Coinbase Wallet preference that avoids Coinbase Smart Wallet, which does not support chain 97741. |
| ERC-4337 | Account abstraction through UserOperations, bundlers and paymasters. |
| ERC-7677 | The paymaster JSON-RPC interface: `pm_getPaymasterStubData`, `pm_getPaymasterData`. |
| Free tier | v2: 100 PEPU per Privy user per day and 50 PEPU per hour, funded by the chain, for PEPU's own Privy app only. Deployed as a canary. |
| Kernel | ZeroDev's smart account. PEPU uses v3.1. |
| Key quorum | A group of authorization keys Privy accepts as a signer; its id is `NEXT_PUBLIC_PRIVY_KEY_QUORUM_ID`. |
| Multicall3 | Batch-read contract. PEPU's is `0x9CE19273Ae9c24437DFF512E8DFCAed4E4B001bd`, not the canonical address. See [The Multicall3 Trap](../contracts/multicall3.md). |
| Owner | The embedded wallet that controls a Kernel account. Also, the owner of a v2 paymaster project. |
| Paymaster | A contract plus policy service that pays UserOperation gas. v2 (canary) is `0xdb28528C9399C33c9A0297E8A62F39145acbC30D`; v1 `0x2B6FED323bFA24f0475f4e1Dd3C7F6Cc1f3ae8B0` is retired. |
| Permission id | The id the chain derives for a session key plus policies; the server compares it with the approval. |
| Permit2 | Uniswap's token approval contract, at the canonical address on PEPU. |
| Policy (Privy) | A Privy rule set attached to a session signer; names at most 49 characters. |
| Policy service | The off-chain ERC-7677 service deciding sponsorship. |
| Privy Smart Wallets | Privy's dashboard feature that builds and manages a Kernel account for the embedded wallet and sends from the browser. Path 2. Needs the Smart Wallets dashboard setting. |
| Project (v2) | A paymaster budget keyed by `keccak256(bytes(appId))`. |
| Server key | A project's secret paymaster credential (`ppk_`), for backends, scripts and the session routes. Never in a browser. |
| Session key | A key allowed to act within limits without a popup. Privy mode or Kernel mode. |
| Session signer | Privy's delegated-actions mechanism on an embedded wallet. |
| SessionStore | The SDK interface storing Kernel session records. `createMemoryStore()` is dev-grade. |
| Smart account | A contract account. Here, a Kernel account with a different address from its owner. See [Two-Address Model](../onboarding/two-address-model.md). |
| Smart account paths | Path 0 plain embedded wallet, Path 1 ZeroDev-native (the SDK builds the Kernel account), Path 2 Privy Smart Wallets (Privy builds it). See [Smart Account Paths](../concepts/smart-account-paths.md). |
| TEE execution | Privy's `user-controlled-server-wallets-only` mode, reassembling keys in an enclave. |
| Timestamp policy | A ZeroDev policy limiting a permission to a validity window. |
| UserOperation | The ERC-4337 transaction-like object a smart account sends. |
| WalletGate | SDK component that renders children once the embedded wallet exists, provisioning it first. |

## Related

- [FAQ](faq.md)
- [The Three Pillars](../get-started/pillars.md)
- [Smart Account Paths](../concepts/smart-account-paths.md)

# Generated API Reference

A complete index of every export of `@pepu-chain/sdk` version 0.2.2, one table per import path, derived from the compiled type declarations. Use it to confirm a symbol exists before you import it. Signatures, behavior, errors and examples are on the per-subpath pages linked from each section.

> Status: proven. The lists below were extracted from the built package with the TypeScript compiler API, so they match the shipped exports and not the source comments.

## How this page is produced

This index comes from a one-off extraction, not a typedoc build. typedoc would add a dev dependency and a config outside `docs/`, and its per-symbol pages would duplicate the signatures that the subpath pages already carry next to their examples and error codes. Two sources keep it honest:

- The SDK test `packages/sdk/test/exports.test.ts` fails when the set of import paths changes.
- The MCP tool `pepu_sdk_exports` returns the export list live from the installed package.

When an export changes, update this page and the subpath page in the same change.

## How it relates to the subpath pages

| You want | Go to |
|---|---|
| Which import path holds a symbol | This page |
| Signature, what it abstracts, server or client, peers, errors, an example | The subpath page, linked under each heading |
| Which subpath for which pillar | [SDK Overview and Reference](reference.md#pillar-to-subpath-decision-table) |
| Error codes | [SDK Error Catalog](errors.md) |

pages.content:
# Core: @pepu-chain/sdk

The core entry of `@pepu-chain/sdk`: chain definitions, the contract and DEX registries, ABIs, gas helpers, explorer links, Multicall3 and Permit2 helpers, the error model, endpoint resolution, ERC-7677 request builders and the live sponsorship check. It extends viem and never wraps it. Read this page first, then the subpath page for the pillar you are building.

> Status: proven. Every registry address is checked on mainnet (`eth_getCode`) and the entry is covered by the SDK test suite. The sponsorship pieces (`checkSponsorship`, the ERC-7677 builders) are proven live on mainnet through the hosted bundler (`https://bundler.pepeunchained.com`) and the hosted paymaster service (`https://paymaster.pepeunchained.com`). The v2 paymaster is Proven on mainnet as a canary (deployed as a canary: internally reviewed 3x, external audit pending, funded in small tranches).

## Install and peer dependencies

```sh
npm install @pepu-chain/sdk viem
```

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Import | `@pepu-chain/sdk` |
| Runs in | Browser, Node, edge. No `react`, no Privy, no ZeroDev |
| Peer dependencies | `viem` `^2.0.0` only |
| Server or client | Client-safe |
| Chain | PEPU mainnet, chain ID `97741`. `pepuTestnet` (`97740`) exists as a definition only and is out of scope |

## Chains and clients

| Export | Signature | What it abstracts |
|---|---|---|
| `pepuMainnet` | viem `Chain` | Chain `97741`, RPC, PepuScan explorer, and `contracts.multicall3` set to PEPU's own address, so viem and wagmi batch correctly |
| `pepuTestnet`, `pepuChains` | viem `Chain`, array | Testnet definition, no explorer, no deployed contracts |
| `isPepuChain` | `(chainId: number) => chainId is 97741 \| 97740` | Narrowing guard |
| `PepuChain`, `PepuChainId` | types | Chain object and ID union |
| `getPublicClient` | `(chain: PepuChain, options?: { transport?: Transport }) => PublicClient<Transport, PepuChain>` | `createPublicClient` with the chain's own RPC |
| `toAddEthereumChainParameter` | `(chain: PepuChain) => AddEthereumChainParameter` | The `wallet_addEthereumChain` payload with correct hex chain ID |
| `switchOrAddPepuChain` | `(provider: EIP1193Provider, chain: PepuChain) => Promise<void>` | Switch, then add on error `4902` (viem's `switchChain` does not add) |

## Contract and DEX registries

| Export | Signature | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `pepuContracts` | registry keyed by chain ID | Names: `create2Factory`, `multicall3`, `permit2`, `entryPoint06`, `entryPoint07`, `kernelFactory`, `kernelMetaFactory`, `ecdsaValidator`, `paymaster`, `kernelImplementation`, `kernelEcdsaSignerModule`, `kernelCallPolicyV004`, `kernelTimestampPolicy`, `tapScore`, `paymasterV1`, `paymasterV2` |
| `getContract` | `(chainId: number, name: PepuContractName) => ContractEntry \| undefined` | Pending entries have no `address` field |
| `listContracts` | `(chainId: number) => readonly ContractEntry[]` | Registry order |
| `isDeployed` | `(entry: ContractEntry \| undefined) => entry is DeployedContract` | Narrow before reading `.address` |
| `getPepuAddresses` | `(chainId?: number) => readonly PepuAddressRow[]` | Flat table for docs and UIs. Returns an **array of rows** (each has a `key`), not an object: use `.find((r) => r.key === "paymaster")`, or `getPepuAddressMap()` |
| `getPepuAddressMap` | `(chainId?: number) => Partial<Record<PepuContractName, PepuAddressRow>>` | The same rows keyed by contract name |
| `pepuSwapContracts`, `getPepuSwapContract`, `listPepuSwapContracts` | PepuSwap registry | `multicallNonCanonical` and `permit2NonCanonical` are PepuSwap's own deployments, not the chain's |
| `pepuTokenList` | Uniswap token-list schema | Four verified tokens: WPEPU (18 decimals), USDT (6), USDC (6) and WETH (18) |
| `createPepuscanClient` | `(chain) => PepuscanClient` | `getVerifiedAbi(address)` and `getTokenMetadata(address)`, both `null` when unknown |

`paymasterV2` and its alias `paymaster` are the v2 paymaster `PepuSponsoredPaymasterV7` at `0xdb28528C9399C33c9A0297E8A62F39145acbC30D`, deployed as a canary: internally reviewed 3x, external audit pending, funded in small tranches. Keep deposits small. `paymasterV1` (`0x2B6FED323bFA24f0475f4e1Dd3C7F6Cc1f3ae8B0`) is retired: its EntryPoint deposit was withdrawn (it was funded earlier), it cannot sponsor anything, and its registry entry carries `retired: true` (so do `getPepuAddresses()` rows). Never deposit to it. A `deployed` registry entry answers "does this contract exist", never "can my app get sponsored gas". Use `checkSponsorship` for that.

Full addresses are in [Address Map](../contracts/address-map.md).

## ABIs

Hand-verified subsets, only functions confirmed live: `wpepuAbi`, `pepuSwapV3FactoryAbi`, `pepuSwapV3PoolAbi`, `pepuSwapRouterAbi`, `pepuSwapQuoterAbi`, `pepuSwapPositionManagerAbi`, `pepuSwapTickLensAbi`, `pepuSwapUniversalRouterAbi`, `pepuSwapPermit2Abi`, `pepuSwapMulticallAbi`, `multicall3Abi`, `permit2Abi`, `arbGasInfoAbi` (with `ARB_GAS_INFO_ADDRESS`), `entryPointV07Abi`, `kernelFactoryAbi` (with `KERNEL_V3_1_IMPLEMENTATION_ADDRESS`), `kernelEcdsaValidatorAbi` (with `ERC7579_MODULE_TYPE`), and viem's `erc20Abi` and `erc721Abi` re-exported so apps import every ABI from one place.

## Gas and fees

PEPU is an Arbitrum Nitro chain. The L2 base fee is about 12,500 gwei and PEPU is a low-value token, so Ethereum-style formatting misleads in both directions.

| Export | Signature |
|---|---|
| `getNitroFeeBreakdown` | `(client) => Promise<NitroFeeBreakdown>` live from the `ArbGasInfo` precompile |
| `explainDualFeeModel` | `() => DualFeeModelExplanation` |
| `estimateTransactionCost` | `(client, request) => Promise<TransactionCostEstimate>` with `gas`, `gasPriceWei`, `costWei`, `costFormatted` |
| `formatPepu` | `(wei: bigint, options?: FormatPepuOptions) => string` (`0.00000001 PEPU`, never `0 PEPU`) |
| `formatPepuGasPrice` | `(weiPerGas: bigint) => string` |
| `formatUnitsCompact` | `(value: bigint, decimals: number, maxFractionDigits = 4) => string` for any token |
| `maxSendableAmount` | `(options: MaxSendableAmountOptions) => Promise<MaxSendableAmountResult>` discriminated on `status`: `ok`, `zero-balance`, `insufficient-for-gas` |
| `DEFAULT_MAX_SEND_MARGIN_BPS` | `2000` (20 percent) |

`maxSendableAmount` is right for a UI that submits transactions itself. Privy's own transaction modal runs a separate, over-conservative balance check and can still refuse an amount this function sized correctly.

## Explorer links

| Export | Signature |
|---|---|
| `explorerUrl` | `(chain, type: "tx" \| "address" \| "token" \| "block", value: string \| number) => string` |
| `txUrl`, `addressUrl`, `tokenUrl`, `blockUrl` | shorthands |
| `explorerLinks` | `(o: { tx?, address?, sender?, token?, block? }, chain = pepuMainnet) => { tx?, address?, sender?, token?, block? }` |

`explorerUrl` throws for a chain with no explorer (`pepuTestnet`). pepuscan has no UserOperation pages, so a sponsored operation is linked by its bundle `tx` and its `sender`. Recipe: [Explorer Links](../recipes/explorer-links.md).

## Multicall3 and Permit2

| Export | Signature | Errors |
|---|---|---|
| `getMulticall3` | `(chainId = 97741) => DeployedContract` | `MULTICALL3_CANONICAL_ADDRESS` if the registry ever held the canonical address, `UNKNOWN` if not deployed on that chain |
| `assertNotCanonicalMulticall3` | `(address) => void` | `MULTICALL3_CANONICAL_ADDRESS` |
| `pepuMulticall` | `(client, calls, { allowFailure?, blockNumber? }) => Promise<MulticallReturnType>` | as `getMulticall3` |
| `encodeAggregate3`, `decodeAggregate3Result` | encode and decode `aggregate3` | none |
| `CANONICAL_MULTICALL3_ADDRESS` | `0xcA11bde05977b3631167028862bE2a173976CA11` | It has no code on PEPU. PEPU's is `0x9CE19273Ae9c24437DFF512E8DFCAed4E4B001bd` |
| `getPermit2`, `permit2Domain` | canonical Permit2 entry and its EIP-712 domain (`name: "Permit2"`, no version) | `UNKNOWN` if not deployed |
| `buildPermitSingleTypedData`, `buildPermitTransferFromTypedData` | typed data for viem `signTypedData` | none |
| `readPermit2Allowance` | `(client, { owner, token, spender }) => Promise<{ amount, expiration, nonce }>` | none |

See [The Multicall3 Trap](../contracts/multicall3.md) and [Permit2](../contracts/permit2.md). Recipes: [Batch Reads with Multicall3](../recipes/batch-reads-with-multicall3.md), [Sign a Permit2 Permit](../recipes/permit2-permit.md).

## Error model

Everything the SDK throws is a `PepuError` with a stable `code`, a one-sentence `hint`, a `docsUrl`, a `retryable` flag and an HTTP `status` for route handlers. Messages name environment variables, never their values.

| Export | Signature |
|---|---|
| `PepuError` and subclasses `PepuConfigError`, `PepuAuthError`, `PepuPolicyError`, `PepuSessionError`, `PepuBundlerError`, `PepuPaymasterError`, `PepuChainError` | `new PepuError(code, message?, { hint?, docsUrl?, retryable?, status?, details?, cause? })` |
| `explainError` | `(e: unknown) => ErrorExplanation` pure, never throws; also decodes raw revert data (`0x...`) |
| `toPepuError` | `(e: unknown, ctx?: { op: string }) => PepuError` |
| `toErrorBody`, `toErrorResponse` | `{ error: { code, message, hint } }` and a JSON `Response` with the catalog status |
| `getErrorEntry`, `errorDocsUrl`, `PEPU_ERROR_CATALOG`, `PEPU_ERRORS_DOCS_URL` | The catalog the MCP tool `pepu_explain_error` also reads |

The full code list is in [SDK Error Catalog](errors.md). Snippet: `docs/snippets/errors.ts`.

```ts
// The SDK error model. See docs/sdk/core.md and docs/sdk/errors.md
import { PepuError, explainError, toErrorResponse, toPepuError } from "@pepu-chain/sdk";

export async function handler(run: () => Promise<unknown>): Promise<Response> {
  try {
    return Response.json(await run());
  } catch (e) {
    // { error: { code, message, hint } } with the status from the catalog.
    return toErrorResponse(e);
  }
}

export function describe(e: unknown): string {
  if (e instanceof PepuError) return `${e.code}: ${e.hint}`;
  const explained = explainError(e);
  return `${explained.code}: ${explained.fix}`;
}

export function retryable(e: unknown): boolean {
  return toPepuError(e, { op: "send" }).retryable;
}
```

Source: `docs/snippets/errors.ts`, type-checked against the SDK.

## Endpoints

```ts
resolvePepuEndpoints(options?: { bundlerUrl?, paymasterUrl?, rpcUrl?, env? }): PepuEndpoints
// { rpcUrl: string; bundlerUrl: string | null; paymasterBaseUrl: string | null; paymasterUrl: string | null; source: "explicit" | "env" | "hosted-default" }
```

Precedence per value: explicit option, then env (the server name, then the `NEXT_PUBLIC_` name), then `PEPU_HOSTED`. Names are in `PEPU_ENV` (`PEPU_BUNDLER_URL`, `PEPU_PAYMASTER_URL`, `PEPU_RPC_URL`) and `PEPU_PUBLIC_ENV` (the `NEXT_PUBLIC_` variants). `PEPU_HOSTED` is the single swap point: `{ bundlerUrl: "https://bundler.pepeunchained.com", paymasterBaseUrl: "https://paymaster.pepeunchained.com", paymasterUrl: null }`. `isHostedSponsorshipLive()` is `true`. The ERC-7677 URL always embeds a project token (`https://paymaster.pepeunchained.com/v2/paymaster/<token>`), so there is no tokenless default and `paymasterUrl` stays `null` until you set `PEPU_PAYMASTER_URL` or pass an option. `paymasterBaseUrl` is the paymaster service base (REST API, probes, `/v2/free-tier`): the hosted base, unless `PEPU_PAYMASTER_URL` is set, in which case it is that URL with the `/v2/paymaster/<token>` tail stripped. For your own services (for example local development) point the variables at `http://localhost:4337` (bundler) and `http://localhost:8788` (paymaster). A malformed value throws `CONFIG_BAD_URL` naming the variable, never the value.

Helpers: `paymasterBaseOf(url)` strips a trailing `/v2/paymaster/<token>` (or `/paymaster/<token>`) and slashes, leaving the service base. `hostedErc7677Url(token)` (from `@pepu-chain/sdk/paymaster`) returns `<hosted base>/v2/paymaster/<token>`; pass a project client token (`ppt_`). `hostedFreeTierUrl()` returns the public `GET` free-tier state route, `https://paymaster.pepeunchained.com/v2/free-tier`. `buildErc7677Url({ baseUrl, token, version })` builds the URL against any base. `requirePaymasterUrl(explicit?, token?)` (from `/aa`) resolves the complete ERC-7677 URL in the order explicit URL, `PEPU_PAYMASTER_URL`, then `token` built against the paymaster base, and otherwise throws `CONFIG_MISSING_ENV`.

A paymaster URL can embed a credential. Treat `PEPU_PAYMASTER_URL` as a secret and never expose it with a `NEXT_PUBLIC_` name unless it holds a publishable client token (`ppt_`).

## Sponsorship status and ERC-7677 builders

| Export | Signature | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `checkSponsorship` | `(options?: CheckSponsorshipOptions) => Promise<SponsorshipReport>` | Probes the bundler and paymaster live. Never throws for an unreachable service. Fields: `available`, `transport`, `bundler`, `paymaster`, `reason`, `fixes` |
| `getSponsorshipStatus` | `(options?) => SponsorshipStatus` | Deprecated. Always `{ available: false }`. See [Migration Notes](migration.md) |
| `getPepuKernelStack` | `(chainId: number) => PepuKernelStack \| undefined` | The five Kernel contracts, `undefined` unless all are deployed |
| `getKernelAccountAddress` | `(client, factory, { data, salt }) => Promise<Address>` | Pass-through to the factory's `getAddress`. Build `data` with `@zerodev/sdk` or use `toPepuKernelAccount` |
| `buildPaymasterContext` | `(entries?) => PaymasterContext` | For example `{ privyAccessToken }` |
| `buildPaymasterStubDataRequest`, `buildPaymasterDataRequest` | `(options: BuildPaymasterRequestOptions) => request` | ERC-7677 JSON-RPC bodies for chain 97741 and EntryPoint v0.7 |

`checkSponsorship` is also exported from `/aa`. The page [/aa](aa.md) has the sponsored-send flow. Snippet: `docs/snippets/check-sponsorship.ts`.

```ts
// Live sponsorship status and the endpoint resolver. See docs/sdk/core.md and docs/sdk/aa.md
import { PEPU_ENV, checkSponsorship, getPublicClient, pepuMainnet, resolvePepuEndpoints } from "@pepu-chain/sdk";

export async function report(): Promise<void> {
  const { bundlerUrl, paymasterBaseUrl, paymasterUrl, source } = resolvePepuEndpoints();
  // The hosted bundler and paymaster service are the defaults. paymasterUrl (the complete ERC-7677 URL)
  // stays null until you set PEPU_PAYMASTER_URL, because that URL embeds a project token
  // (names only below: values can embed credentials).
  console.log(PEPU_ENV.bundlerUrl, bundlerUrl !== null, paymasterBaseUrl !== null, PEPU_ENV.paymasterUrl, paymasterUrl !== null, source);

  const s = await checkSponsorship({ publicClient: getPublicClient(pepuMainnet) });
  console.log(s.available, s.reason);
  for (const fix of s.fixes) console.log(`- ${fix}`);
}
```

Source: `docs/snippets/check-sponsorship.ts`, type-checked against the SDK.

## Common failures

| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `explorerUrl: no block explorer is configured` | You passed `pepuTestnet` | Use `pepuMainnet`. Testnet has no explorer |
| `TS2339: Property 'address' does not exist on type 'ContractEntry'` | You skipped `isDeployed` | Narrow with `isDeployed(entry)` first |
| Multicall returns empty data | A hand-written chain definition uses the canonical Multicall3 | Use `pepuMainnet` or `pepuMulticall` |
| `CONFIG_BAD_URL` | A set `PEPU_*_URL` is not an `http(s)` URL | Fix the variable the message names |
| `checkSponsorship` says no URL is configured | A variable was cleared, or the paymaster has no token | The hosted bundler and paymaster service are the defaults. Set `PEPU_PAYMASTER_URL` to `https://paymaster.pepeunchained.com/v2/paymaster/<token>` (or pass a token), or point both variables at your own services |

## Related

- [SDK Overview and Reference](reference.md)
- [Network Reference](../get-started/network-reference.md)
- [Address Map](../contracts/address-map.md)

pages.title: /doctor
pages.content:
# /doctor

`@pepu-chain/sdk/doctor` runs project readiness checks: environment variables, Privy app id format, chain RPC, bundler and paymaster reachability, and the Privy dashboard settings. It never returns or logs a value from your environment: presence and length only.

> Status: proven. It backs the CLI doctor, the MCP tools `pepu_check_env` and `pepu_check_privy_config`, and the `/pepu-doctor` command.

## Import, peers and boundary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Import | `@pepu-chain/sdk/doctor` |
| Server or client | Node or any runtime with `fetch`. Use it in scripts and server code; it reads an env map you pass in |
| Peer dependencies | None (the key generator uses WebCrypto) |

## Exports

| Export | Signature | What it abstracts |
|---|---|---|
| `runDoctor` | `(o: RunDoctorOptions) => Promise<DoctorReport>` | Every check in one call. `RunDoctorOptions`: `env`, `template?`, `pillars?`, `fetch?`, `offline?`, `checkPrivyDashboard?` |
| `checkPepuEnv` | `(o: { env; template?; pillars? }) => EnvCheckResult` | Per-variable verdict: `ok`, `missing`, `placeholder` or `malformed`, with `secret`, `length`, `required` and a `fix`. Never the value |
| `checkChainRpc` | `(o?: { rpcUrl?; fetch? }) => Promise<DoctorCheck>` | The RPC answers and reports chain 97741 |
| `checkPrivyAppIdFormat` | `(appId: string \| undefined) => DoctorCheck` | `PRIVY_APP_ID_PATTERN`: a leading `c` then 20 to 29 lowercase alphanumerics |
| `checkSponsorshipEndpoints` | `(o?: { env?; fetch? }) => Promise<DoctorCheck[]>` | The hosted bundler and paymaster service are the defaults and are probed (the paymaster at `<base>/health`); a URL that resolves to nothing is a skip, and one that is set but unreachable is a failure. URLs never appear in messages |
| `TEMPLATE_REQUIREMENTS` | `Record<string, TemplateRequirement>` | Per-template env and Privy dashboard needs: `requiredEnv`, `optionalEnv`, `requiredAnyOf?`, `pillars`, `privyDashboard` |
| `generatePrivyAuthorizationKey` | `() => Promise<PrivyAuthorizationKeyPair>` | A P-256 key pair in the format Privy expects (`publicKey` base64 SPKI, `privateKey` base64 PKCS8). Writes and logs nothing. Register the public half in the dashboard, keep the private half in server env only |
| Types | `DoctorCheck`, `DoctorReport`, `EnvCheckResult`, `EnvItem`, `EnvItemStatus`, `CheckStatus`, `Pillar`, `PrivyDashboardChecker`, `PrivyDashboardRequirementKey`, `TemplateRequirement`, `RunDoctorOptions`, `PrivyAuthorizationKeyPair` | |

`Pillar` is `login`, `wallet`, `session`, `sponsorship`, `gate` or `mint`. `CheckStatus` is `pass`, `fail`, `warn` or `skip`. `DoctorReport` is `{ ok, checks, env }` and `ok` is true when no check failed.

Plug in the Privy dashboard check with `privyDashboardChecker` from [/privy](privy.md). Without it the report carries a `privy.dashboard` skip.

## Example

```ts
// Readiness checks for a project. See docs/sdk/doctor.md
import { runDoctor } from "@pepu-chain/sdk/doctor";
import { privyDashboardChecker } from "@pepu-chain/sdk/privy";

export async function check(): Promise<boolean> {
  const report = await runDoctor({
    env: process.env,
    template: "sponsored-session-app",
    // Adds the Privy dashboard checks (login methods, allowed origins, wallet creation setting).
    checkPrivyDashboard: privyDashboardChecker,
  });
  // Env values never appear in the report: presence and length only.
  for (const c of report.checks) {
    if (c.status === "fail" || c.status === "warn") console.log(c.status, c.id, c.fix ?? c.message);
  }
  return report.ok;
}
```

Source: `docs/snippets/doctor.ts`, type-checked against the SDK.

## Errors

`runDoctor` reports problems as `DoctorCheck`s and does not throw for a failing project. An unknown `template` becomes a failing `template` check. `generatePrivyAuthorizationKey` can reject if WebCrypto is unavailable.

## Common failures

| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `env.PEPU_BUNDLER_URL is missing` for a sponsorship template | The variable was cleared, or the template needs an explicit value | Set it to `https://bundler.pepeunchained.com` (the hosted bundler) or your own bundler (local default `http://localhost:4337`) |
| `privy.dashboard` is skipped | No checker injected, unknown template, or no app id | Pass `checkPrivyDashboard: privyDashboardChecker` |
| A check says `placeholder` | The value is still `your-...` or `<...>` from `.env.example` | Replace it with the real value |

## Related

- [Privy Env Vars and Verification](../privy/env-and-checks.md)
- [Environment Variables](../reference/env-vars.md)
- [/privy](privy.md)

pages.title: SDK Error Catalog
pages.content: # SDK Error Catalog Everything `@pepu-chain/sdk` throws is a `PepuError` subclass with a stable `code`, a one-sentence `hint` and a `docsUrl`. This page is the catalog as a table, with the helpers that read it: `explainError`, `toPepuError`, `toErrorBody` and `toErrorResponse`. The long-form entries, with anchors, are on [Error Reference](../reference/errors.md). > Status: generated from `PEPU_ERROR_CATALOG` (37 codes). Built and tested. `node scripts/gen-docs.mjs --check` fails CI if this page drifts from the code. ## Prerequisites - `@pepu-chain/sdk` installed. The error helpers are exported from the package root. ## Using the catalog ```ts import { PepuError, explainError, toErrorResponse } from "@pepu-chain/sdk"; // Explain anything: an Error, an error message, or raw revert data (0x...). Pure; never throws. export function describe(e: unknown): string { const x = explainError(e); return `${x.code}: ${x.fix} (${x.docsUrl})`; } // Route handlers: return the typed error as JSON with the catalog's HTTP status. export async function POST(): Promise { try { throw new PepuError("CONFIG_MISSING_ENV"); } catch (e) { return toErrorResponse(e); // { error: { code, message, hint } } } } ``` | Helper | Does | |---|---| | `explainError(e)` | Returns `{ code, title, cause, fix, docsUrl, matched }` for an error, a message or revert data. First matching catalog entry wins. | | `toPepuError(e, ctx?)` | Wraps anything thrown into the right `PepuError` subclass. `PepuError`s pass through. | | `toErrorBody(e)` | The `{ error: { code, message, hint } }` JSON body. | | `toErrorResponse(e)` | A `Response` with that body and the status from the table below. | | `errorDocsUrl(code)` | `https://guide.pepeunchained.com/reference/errors#` | | `mapPaymasterReason(reason)` | Paymaster denial reason to catalog code. See [Error Reference](../reference/errors.md#paymaster-denial-reasons). | ## Catalog | Code | HTTP | Retryable | Title | Cause | Fix | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | [`CONFIG_BAD_URL`](../reference/errors.md#CONFIG_BAD_URL) | 500 | no | Invalid endpoint URL | A configured bundler, paymaster or RPC URL is not a valid http(s) URL. | Use a full URL such as https://bundler.example.com. | | [`CONFIG_MISSING_ENV`](../reference/errors.md#CONFIG_MISSING_ENV) | 500 | no | Missing environment variable | A required environment variable is not set. | Set the listed variables (see .env.example) and restart the process. | | [`CONFIG_ORIGIN_MISMATCH`](../reference/errors.md#CONFIG_ORIGIN_MISMATCH) | 500 | no | Origin is not allowed by Privy | The page origin (scheme, host and port) is not in the Privy app's allowed origins. A different dev port is the usual cause. | Add the exact origin, including the port, to Privy dashboard Allowed origins. | | [`CONFIG_PRIVY_CREATE_ON_LOGIN`](../reference/errors.md#CONFIG_PRIVY_CREATE_ON_LOGIN) | 500 | no | Embedded wallet never appears after login | The dashboard's automatic embedded wallet creation is off, so createOnLogin never resolves. | Create the wallet server-side with the ensure-wallet route (createEnsureWalletRoute), or enable creation in the Privy dashboard. | | [`CONFIG_PRIVY_DASHBOARD`](../reference/errors.md#CONFIG_PRIVY_DASHBOARD) | 500 | no | Privy dashboard misconfiguration | A required Privy dashboard setting is missing. | Run checkPrivyDashboardConfig() and follow its fix list. | | [`CONFIG_SERVER_ONLY`](../reference/errors.md#CONFIG_SERVER_ONLY) | 500 | no | Server-only module imported in the browser | A server entry point was bundled into client code. | Import server entries only from route handlers, server actions and scripts. | | [`AUTH_INVALID_TOKEN`](../reference/errors.md#AUTH_INVALID_TOKEN) | 401 | no | Invalid or missing Privy access token | The request carried no bearer token, or Privy could not verify it. | Send Authorization: Bearer and verify the token server-side. | | [`WALLET_COINBASE_UNSUPPORTED_CHAIN`](../reference/errors.md#WALLET_COINBASE_UNSUPPORTED_CHAIN) | 400 | no | Coinbase Smart Wallet does not support PEPU | Coinbase Smart Wallet is a smart-contract wallet on chains it knows; PEPU (97741) is not one of them, and it floods the console with unsupported-chain errors. | Pin Coinbase to eoaOnly via createPepuPrivyConfig() from @pepu-chain/sdk/privy. | | [`WALLET_INJECTED_ACTIVE`](../reference/errors.md#WALLET_INJECTED_ACTIVE) | 400 | no | An injected browser wallet is the active account | wagmi's active account is a browser extension rather than the Privy embedded wallet. | Pin the embedded wallet with useActiveWalletPin() from @pepu-chain/sdk/privy/wagmi. | | [`WALLET_NOT_PROVISIONED`](../reference/errors.md#WALLET_NOT_PROVISIONED) | 409 | yes | User has no embedded wallet yet | The user is signed in but no embedded Ethereum wallet exists. | Call the ensure-wallet route (useEnsureWallet or WalletGate) before acting. | | [`PRIVY_CHAIN_REJECTED_97741`](../reference/errors.md#PRIVY_CHAIN_REJECTED_97741) | 502 | no | Privy rejects server-side eth_sendTransaction on PEPU | Privy's server-side send path does not know chain 97741 and rejects it. Signing works; sending does not. | Sign with eth_signTransaction on the server and broadcast the raw transaction yourself (signAndBroadcast from @pepu-chain/sdk/session). | | [`PRIVY_KEY_QUORUM_MISMATCH`](../reference/errors.md#PRIVY_KEY_QUORUM_MISMATCH) | 500 | no | Privy authorization key does not match the wallet owner | Privy returned 401 'No valid authorization keys or user signing keys available': the server's PRIVY_AUTHORIZATION_KEY is not a signer on the wallet, or the key quorum id differs from the one the user granted. | Make sure PRIVY_AUTHORIZATION_KEY is the private half of the key whose quorum id is NEXT_PUBLIC_PRIVY_KEY_QUORUM_ID, and that the user granted that quorum as a signer. | | [`POLICY_NAME_TOO_LONG`](../reference/errors.md#POLICY_NAME_TOO_LONG) | 400 | no | Privy policy or rule name is too long | Privy rejects policy and rule names of 50 or more characters (the real limit is 49). | Shorten the policy or rule name to 49 characters or fewer. | | [`POLICY_UNSCOPED`](../reference/errors.md#POLICY_UNSCOPED) | 400 | no | Session policy is not scoped | A session policy needs a target contract, at least one function and an expiry. | Pass contractAddress, functions and expiresAtUnixSeconds to buildSessionPolicy(). | | [`SESSION_APPROVAL_MISMATCH`](../reference/errors.md#SESSION_APPROVAL_MISMATCH) | 409 | no | Session approval does not match | The approval was made for another account, permission id or mode. | Re-run prepare, have the owner sign again, then activate. | | [`SESSION_EXPIRED`](../reference/errors.md#SESSION_EXPIRED) | 410 | no | Session expired | The session's expiry has passed. | Grant a new session. | | [`SESSION_NONE`](../reference/errors.md#SESSION_NONE) | 409 | no | No active session | The user has not granted a session, or it was revoked. | Ask the user to grant a session first. | | [`BUNDLER_AA_FAILED`](../reference/errors.md#BUNDLER_AA_FAILED) | 502 | no | EntryPoint rejected the UserOperation | The EntryPoint reported FailedOp with an AAxx code during validation or execution. | Read the AAxx code: AA21 prefund missing, AA23 signature or validation reverted, AA25 invalid nonce, AA31/AA33/AA34 paymaster problems. | | [`BUNDLER_UNREACHABLE`](../reference/errors.md#BUNDLER_UNREACHABLE) | 502 | yes | Bundler or paymaster is unreachable | The request to the bundler or paymaster URL failed before any response. | Check PEPU_BUNDLER_URL and PEPU_PAYMASTER_URL. The hosted services may not be live yet; use checkSponsorship(). | | [`PAYMASTER_API_ERROR`](../reference/errors.md#PAYMASTER_API_ERROR) | 502 | no | Paymaster API request failed | The paymaster API returned an error that has no more specific PEPU code. | Read error.details (HTTP status and the service's error code) and the OpenAPI spec for that route. | | [`PAYMASTER_CAP`](../reference/errors.md#PAYMASTER_CAP) | 429 | yes | Sponsorship cap reached | A daily, per-sender or per-operation sponsorship cap was hit. | Wait for the cap window to reset, or raise the project's daily and sender limits. | | [`PAYMASTER_DENIED`](../reference/errors.md#PAYMASTER_DENIED) | 403 | no | Paymaster denied the sponsorship | The paymaster rejected the credential or the sender (for example unknown_or_invalid_app_credential or sender_not_owned_by_token_user). | Check the app credential or token, and that the smart account belongs to the user whose access token you sent. | | [`PAYMASTER_DESTINATION_NOT_ALLOWED`](../reference/errors.md#PAYMASTER_DESTINATION_NOT_ALLOWED) | 403 | no | Paymaster refused the call destination | The UserOperation targets a contract that is not on the project's target allowlist. | Add the contract to the project's targets, or sponsor only calls to allowed targets. | | [`PAYMASTER_FREE_TIER_UNAVAILABLE`](../reference/errors.md#PAYMASTER_FREE_TIER_UNAVAILABLE) | 429 | yes | Free tier cannot sponsor this operation | The free tier is disabled, its pool is empty, or the operation is larger than the per-op cap. | Deposit into your own project and use its credentials, or retry later. | | [`PAYMASTER_IDENTITY_REQUIRED`](../reference/errors.md#PAYMASTER_IDENTITY_REQUIRED) | 401 | no | A verified Privy account is required | The free tier (and any project with requireIdentity on) only sponsors users with a verified Privy access token. | Send the user's Privy access token as Authorization: Bearer (or context.privyAccessToken for ERC-7677). | | [`PAYMASTER_NO_BALANCE`](../reference/errors.md#PAYMASTER_NO_BALANCE) | 429 | yes | Sponsorship project has no balance | The project's paymaster deposit cannot cover this operation. | Deposit more PEPU to the project, then retry. | | [`PAYMASTER_ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED`](../reference/errors.md#PAYMASTER_ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED) | 403 | no | Paymaster refused the request origin | The request Origin is not on the project's allowlist. | Add the exact origin (scheme, host and port) to the project's allowed origins. | | [`PAYMASTER_PROJECT_NOT_CLAIMED`](../reference/errors.md#PAYMASTER_PROJECT_NOT_CLAIMED) | 409 | no | Sponsorship project is not claimed on-chain | Deposits can sit in an unclaimed project, but nothing is sponsored until its owner has claimed it on-chain (the contract reports ProjectNotClaimed, the service project_not_claimed_onchain). | Prove the Privy app (requestClaimAttestation from @pepu-chain/sdk/paymaster/server), call claimProject, then configureProject (setTargets, setDailyLimit, setSenderDailyLimit). | | [`PAYMASTER_PROJECT_OWNER_CHANGED`](../reference/errors.md#PAYMASTER_PROJECT_OWNER_CHANGED) | 403 | no | Project owner changed since the credentials were issued | The on-chain owner of the project is no longer the address the off-chain credentials were issued to (an ownership transfer or re-claim completed). | As the new owner, sign in with SIWE, register the project again and rotate the client token and server key. | | [`PAYMASTER_PROJECT_PAUSED`](../reference/errors.md#PAYMASTER_PROJECT_PAUSED) | 403 | no | Sponsorship project is paused | The project owner paused sponsorship on-chain. | The owner can resume it with setPaused(projectId, false). | | [`PAYMASTER_RATE_LIMITED`](../reference/errors.md#PAYMASTER_RATE_LIMITED) | 429 | yes | Paymaster API rate limit | Too many requests to the paymaster API from this IP or account. | Back off for the Retry-After interval (error.details.retryAfterSeconds when present). | | [`PAYMASTER_SESSION_REQUIRED`](../reference/errors.md#PAYMASTER_SESSION_REQUIRED) | 401 | no | Paymaster owner session missing or expired | Owner endpoints need a SIWE session token (1 h lifetime) for the project's current on-chain owner. | Call loginWithWallet() on the paymaster API client, then retry. | | [`MULTICALL3_CANONICAL_ADDRESS`](../reference/errors.md#MULTICALL3_CANONICAL_ADDRESS) | 500 | no | Canonical Multicall3 address used on PEPU | PEPU's Multicall3 is not at the canonical 0xcA11...CA11 address. | Use getMulticall3() or pepuMulticall() from @pepu-chain/sdk, or the pepuMainnet chain object, which carries the right address. | | [`TX_GAS_UNDERSHOOT`](../reference/errors.md#TX_GAS_UNDERSHOOT) | 502 | yes | Gas limit too low | Nitro gas estimation undershoots on PEPU: the L1 data component is not covered by the plain estimate. | Add headroom to the estimate, 20% via withGasLimitBuffer() from @pepu-chain/sdk/session. | | [`TX_NONCE_RACE`](../reference/errors.md#TX_NONCE_RACE) | 409 | yes | Nonce conflict | Two transactions raced for one nonce, or a replacement was underpriced. | Serialize sends per account (a lock), re-read the pending nonce, and retry. | | [`TX_REVERTED`](../reference/errors.md#TX_REVERTED) | 502 | no | Transaction reverted | The contract call reverted. | Decode the revert reason with explainError() and check arguments, allowances and balances. | | [`UNKNOWN`](../reference/errors.md#UNKNOWN) | 500 | no | Unknown error | The error did not match any known PEPU failure. | Read the original message. Run pepu_known_gotchas in the MCP server, or search the docs. | ## What to expect - Messages name environment variables, never their values. Nothing in this catalog is a secret. - Order in the catalog matters for `explainError`: specific entries match before general ones. ## Common failures - `explainError` returns `UNKNOWN` for an error you expected to match: the SDK is older than the error text. Upgrade, or open the [Error Reference](../reference/errors.md) and search the symptom. ## Related - [Error Reference](../reference/errors.md) - [Troubleshooting](../troubleshooting.md) - [SDK Overview and Reference](reference.md) - [Core: @pepu-chain/sdk](core.md)

pages.title: Migration Notes
pages.content:
# Migration Notes

Upgrade notes for `@pepu-chain/sdk`. The only upgrade today is 0.1 to 0.2. It adds subpaths and keeps every 0.1 export, so no code has to change to upgrade, but one helper is deprecated and several hand-rolled patterns now have SDK replacements.

> Status: proven. Every 0.1 export is still present in 0.2.2 (the exports test and the type-check of `docs/snippets` run against the 0.2.2 build). The full list of changes is in the [Changelog](../reference/changelog.md).

## 0.1 to 0.2

### Breaking changes

None. Additive only.

### Deprecated

| 0.1 | Status in 0.2 | Replacement |
|---|---|---|
| `getSponsorshipStatus(options?)` | Deprecated. Still exported from `@pepu-chain/sdk` and `/aa`. Always returns `{ available: false, reason }` and ignores `bundlerUrl` | `checkSponsorship(options?)`, a live probe of the bundler and paymaster |
| `useSponsorshipStatus(options?)` from `/react` | Deprecated for the same reason | `usePepuSponsorship({ pollMs? })` from `/aa/react` |

```ts
// 0.1
import { getSponsorshipStatus } from "@pepu-chain/sdk";
const { available } = getSponsorshipStatus(); // always false

// 0.2
import { checkSponsorship, getPublicClient, pepuMainnet } from "@pepu-chain/sdk";
const s = await checkSponsorship({ publicClient: getPublicClient(pepuMainnet) });
if (!s.available) console.log(s.reason, s.fixes);
```

`checkSponsorship` resolves the bundler and paymaster URLs from options, then env (`PEPU_BUNDLER_URL`, `PEPU_PAYMASTER_URL`), then the hosted defaults: the hosted bundler (`https://bundler.pepeunchained.com`) and the hosted paymaster service base (`https://paymaster.pepeunchained.com`). The complete ERC-7677 paymaster URL has no default because it embeds a project token. It probes both and reports `available`, `transport`, `reason` and `fixes`. It never throws for an unreachable service.

### New subpaths

| Subpath | Replaces this hand-rolled code |
|---|---|
| `/privy`, `/privy/react`, `/privy/wagmi`, `/privy/server` | Your own `PrivyProvider` config, wallet gate, wagmi config, active-wallet pin and ensure-wallet route. See [Provision the Wallet and Pin the Active Account](../recipes/provision-and-pin-the-wallet.md) |
| `/session`, `/session/server`, `/session/react` | Your own session policy builder, grant, status and revoke routes and sign-then-broadcast code. See [Grant a Session](../recipes/grant-a-session.md) |
| `/session/kernel` | Hand-built ZeroDev permission validators and approval handling |
| `/aa`, `/aa/kernel`, `/aa/react` | Your own bundler and paymaster clients, the Alto fee estimator, UserOperation error decoding and receipt parsing. See [Send a Sponsored Transaction](../recipes/sponsored-send.md) |
| `/paymaster`, `/paymaster/server` | Direct calls to the policy service and hand-encoded v2 contract calls |
| `/combo`, `/combo/react` | The five session routes and the browser flow in the `sponsored-session-app` template |
| `/doctor` | Ad hoc env checks |
| `/server` | Kept as a stable path that re-exports the pure session policy helpers. New server code lives in `/privy/server`, `/session/server` and `/paymaster/server` |

### New exports on existing paths

On `@pepu-chain/sdk`: the error model (`PepuError` and subclasses, `explainError`, `toPepuError`, `toErrorBody`, `toErrorResponse`, `PEPU_ERROR_CATALOG`), `resolvePepuEndpoints` and `PEPU_ENV`, `pepuMulticall` and `getMulticall3`, `getPermit2` and the Permit2 typed-data builders, `explorerLinks`, `getPepuAddresses`, `formatUnitsCompact`, `erc20Abi` and `erc721Abi`, `multicall3Abi`, `permit2Abi`, `checkSponsorship`. The registry gained `kernelImplementation`, `kernelEcdsaSignerModule`, `kernelCallPolicyV004`, `kernelTimestampPolicy`, `tapScore`, `paymasterV1` and `paymasterV2` (pending).

### Behavior changes to know about

- `pepuContracts.multicall3` was always PEPU's own address. Code that hard-coded the canonical address `0xcA11bde05977b3631167028862bE2a173976CA11` was always wrong on PEPU. Use `pepuMulticall` or `getMulticall3`, which throws `MULTICALL3_CANONICAL_ADDRESS` rather than use it.
- Everything the SDK throws now carries a stable `code`. Replace string matching on messages with `error.code` or `explainError(e)`.
- Route factories (`createSessionRoutes`, `createSessionActionRoute`, `createSponsoredSessionRoutes`) answer `CONFIG_MISSING_ENV` as JSON at request time when the contract address is empty, instead of throwing at module load.

### Checklist

1. Upgrade: `npm install @pepu-chain/sdk@^0.2.2 viem`.
2. Replace `getSponsorshipStatus` and `useSponsorshipStatus` with `checkSponsorship` and `usePepuSponsorship`.
3. Install the optional peers for the subpaths you adopt (see the [peer table](reference.md#subpath-map-and-peer-dependencies)).
4. Swap hand-rolled infrastructure for the SDK function. Keep your code where the SDK has no equivalent.
5. Run the doctor: `runDoctor({ env: process.env })` from [/doctor](doctor.md).

## Related

- [Changelog](../reference/changelog.md)
- [SDK Overview and Reference](reference.md)
- [SDK Error Catalog](errors.md)
